root_cause: Top-level control asserts start_post at load_done (same time as start_compute) and enters ST_COMPUTE, but postproc_relu_bias only accepts acc_valid after start_post and has no buffering/handshake with gemm_core_seq. This start/stream alignment defect corrupts output ordering/data (seen in first test mismatch) and leads to non-terminating regression progression reported as timeout.

first_divergence.expected: Reference row-major output begins [1,0,0,0,...] for A[0][0]=1, B[0][0]=1, zero bias.

evidence.observation: First test test_directed_basic fails at 29460ns with AssertionError: Output mismatch; expected vs got differs immediately.
evidence.relevance: Earliest authoritative functional failure in this run is wrong output, not compile/elaboration.

evidence.observation: Overall cocotb stage marked TIMEOUT/SIMULATION_TIMEOUT after entering regression.
evidence.relevance: Confirms run-level failure class remains SIMULATION_TIMEOUT per context.

evidence.observation: In ST_LOAD when load_done, top asserts both start_compute and start_post in same cycle, then transitions to ST_COMPUTE.
evidence.relevance: Creates coupling risk where postprocess activation is not tied to actual acc stream completion/phase.

evidence.observation: Module accepts acc_valid only when active and !pend; single-entry pending path with no backpressure/ready to gemm_core_seq.
evidence.relevance: If activation/stream timing is off, samples can be dropped/misaligned, directly causing output mismatches and downstream completion issues.
